purpose: Canonical edge and provenance schema for the shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer.

storedShape.soldierId: integer; canonical Soldier ID for the exact normal or SP form represented by this edge; required
storedShape.provenance: non-empty array of provenance entries; required

canonicalEdge.reasonForMinimalShape: Identity and presentation metadata remain owned by Hero Master and Soldier Master. The relation edge stores only the canonical pair and evidence for why that pair exists.

requiredCommonFields.sourceKind: one of BASE_SOLDIER_HERO, SP_HERO_REWARD, SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND, SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT

origin.table: ConfigData table that directly contains the originating relation evidence
origin.recordId: canonical ID of the source record
origin.field: relation field in that source record

provenanceEntry.directRule: DIRECT entries stop at origin; the canonical edge pair determines which member of the source field is being evidenced.
provenanceEntry.derivedRule: SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT entries must additionally contain parentEdge and supportRelation, while retaining the original DIRECT origin copied from the parent provenance.

parentEdge.heroId: same Hero ID as the derived edge
parentEdge.soldierId: normal Soldier ID from which the relation is inherited

mergeRules: The canonical edge set is keyed only by exact (heroId, soldierId).
If multiple allowed sources produce the same pair, keep one canonical edge and append all distinct provenance entries.
Never collapse different provenance source kinds into a single generic reason string.
Never overwrite an earlier provenance entry when a later source produces the same edge.
Exact duplicate provenance entries are deduplicated structurally.
For SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT, create one derived provenance entry per eligible parent provenance so the original direct origin remains traceable.
SP_FORM_LINK alone never creates an edge or provenance entry because it is support-only.
integrityRules: Every edge.heroId must exist in the canonical Hero Master.
Every edge.soldierId must exist in the canonical Soldier Master.
Every provenance.sourceKind must be allowed by the A-3 source contract.
DIRECT provenance must match the authoritative table/field pair defined for its sourceKind.
SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT must have sourceClass DERIVED, a valid parentEdge, and a valid SP_FORM_LINK supportRelation.
For inherited edges, parentEdge.heroId must equal edge.heroId and supportRelation.spSoldierId must equal edge.soldierId.
For inherited edges, parentEdge.soldierId must equal supportRelation.normalSoldierId.
Presentation metadata must be resolved from masters at read time rather than copied into the canonical edge.

determinismRules.edgeOrder: sort by soldierId ascending, then heroId ascending when serialized
determinismRules.provenanceOrder: sort by sourceKind, origin.table, origin.recordId, origin.field, then parentEdge.soldierId when present
determinismRules.purpose: Stable diffs and reproducible regression comparison. Ordering does not change semantic identity.

migrationFromStage3.oldShape: Soldier-centric rows containing finalHeroIds plus source-specific Hero ID arrays.
migrationFromStage3.newShape: One canonical record per heroId-soldierId pair with provenance[] attached directly to that pair.
migrationFromStage3.rule: Do not mutate the frozen stage-3 output in A-4. The new schema becomes the target for the shared Relation Layer builder implemented later.

completion: A-4 is complete when all later relation builders and indexes are required to emit and consume one canonical edge per (heroId, soldierId) with non-empty provenance[] conforming to this schema.
